map.计算自动喷水灭火系统喷头数量、作用面积、设计流量与供水压力: Compute the sprinkler count, operating area, design flow and water-supply pressure of an automatic sprinkler system.
map.喷头流量 q = K·√P（K 流量系数，P 工作压力 MPa）；开放喷头数 N: Sprinkler flow q = K·√P (K = flow coefficient, P = working pressure in MPa); open-head count N = operating area Aₒₚ ÷ head coverage area a; system design flow Q = N·q (L/min), then checked against the code-required spray density.
map.系统作用面积（m²，留空自动取标准值）: System operating area (m², leave blank to use the standard value)
map.单喷头流量 q = K × √(10P)，K 为流量系数，P 为工作压力（MPa: Single-sprinkler flow q = K × √(10P), K is the flow coefficient, P is the working pressure (MPa), q in L/min
map.系统设计流量 Qs = 作用面积内喷头流量之和（考虑同时开启）: System design flow Qs = sum of the sprinkler flows within the operating area (considering simultaneous opening)
map.轻危险级：作用面积 160m²，喷水强度 4 L/(min·m²): Light hazard: operating area 160 m², spray density 4 L/(min·m²)
map.中危Ⅰ级：作用面积 160m²，喷水强度 6 L/(min·m²): Ordinary hazard Class I: operating area 160 m², spray density 6 L/(min·m²)
map.中危Ⅱ级：作用面积 160m²，喷水强度 8 L/(min·m²): Ordinary hazard Class II: operating area 160 m², spray density 8 L/(min·m²)
map.严危Ⅰ级：作用面积 260m²，喷水强度 12 L/(min·m²): Extra hazard Class I: operating area 260 m², spray density 12 L/(min·m²)
map.严危Ⅱ级：作用面积 260m²，喷水强度 16 L/(min·m²): Extra hazard Class II: operating area 260 m², spray density 16 L/(min·m²)
map.本工具依据《自动喷水灭火系统设计规范》GB 50084 提供估算，正式设计须结合: This tool provides estimates based on the Code for Design of Sprinkler Systems (GB 50084); the formal design must be determined together with hydraulic pipe calculations.
map.📚 深度解析：自动喷淋系统设计: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Automatic Sprinkler System Design
map.自喷系统设计时按危险等级确定作用面积、喷水强度与喷头布置。: In sprinkler system design, determine the operating area, spray density and sprinkler layout by hazard level.
map.校核最不利作用面积内的流量与系统流量是否满足规范最低要求。: Verify whether the flow within the most unfavorable operating area and the system flow meet the code minimum.
map.改造或扩容时反算消防水池储量是否满足 1~2 小时灭火用水。: When renovating or expanding, back-calculate whether the fire water-storage volume meets 1-2 hours of firefighting water use.
map.中危Ⅰ级、作用面积 160 m² 的设计: Design for Ordinary hazard Class I, operating area 160 m²
map.按默认参数（中危Ⅰ级、标准作用面积 160 m²、标准喷水强度 6 L/(min: With the default parameters (Ordinary hazard Class I, standard operating area 160 m², standard spray density 6 L/(min·m²)): about 13 sprinklers within the operating area (spacing about 3.6 m), single-sprinkler flow 80 L/min; system design flow = 1040 L/min = 17.3 L/s, actual spray density 6.5 L/(min·m²) ≥ standard 6, meeting the design requirement. Recommended fire water-storage volume 1040 L (1 hour) to 2080 L (2 hours).
map.喷水强度为什么取 6 L/(min·m²)？: Why is the spray density taken as 6 L/(min·m²)?
map.来自 GB 50084 按火灾危险等级的规定：中危Ⅰ级为 6、中危Ⅱ级为 8、严: It comes from GB 50084's provisions by fire hazard class: Ordinary hazard Class I is 6, Class II is 8, and extra hazard is higher; the design spray density must not be below the lower limit of the corresponding class, otherwise the fire cannot be controlled effectively.
map.为什么系统流量用 13×80 而不是面积×强度？: Why use 13×80 for the system flow instead of area × density?
map.作用面积法以「最不利作用面积内同时开放的喷头数×单喷头流量」控制系统流量，已隐含: The operating-area method controls the system flow by 'number of sprinklers simultaneously open within the most unfavorable operating area × single-sprinkler flow', which already implies the sprinkler spacing and pressure distribution and is closer to the actual spray distribution than simple area × density.
map.基于自动喷水灭火系统设计规范，计算喷头数量、系统设计流量与喷水强度，并校核是否满: Based on the sprinkler system design code, compute the sprinkler count, system design flow and spray density, and verify compliance with the hazard-level requirements.
